full_prompt_en: A square monochrome stippled drawing centers a large round owl eye on pale paper, with a hand and pen entering from the right to add marks beside it. The eye fills the left half of the frame. Its dark circular pupil is set inside a softly shaded iris, and a thick black lower rim gives the gaze a striking graphic weight. Around the eye, short feather-like strokes and hundreds of closely spaced dots build rings of gray texture. The upper brow is darker and more densely hatched, while the surrounding pale paper stays visible between individual marks. Along the lower left, overlapping speckled plumage forms a rough patterned field. To the right of the eye, the creature's contour becomes lighter and less complete, leaving a large white gap in the upper right. A human hand enters from the center-right, its fingers holding a fine dark pen whose nib touches the area just beyond the eye's lower outer corner. The hand is rendered more smoothly and softly than the drawing beneath it, making the act of mark-making clear without competing with the eye. There is no background setting; the paper surface and the contrast between dark dots and white space make up the entire scene. Even diffuse light keeps the page bright, with only a faint soft shadow under the hand. Dense stippling makes the deepest blacks, while widely spaced dots turn into mid-gray and then dissolve into untouched paper. The overall composition concentrates extraordinary detail around one circular focal point and lets the hand and open white margin reveal how the image is built.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形单色点描画以浅色纸上的一只大而圆的猫头鹰眼睛为中心，右侧伸入一只手和一支笔，在眼旁继续添上点痕。眼睛填满左半幅，深色圆瞳居于柔和明暗塑造的虹膜中，厚黑下眼缘赋予目光鲜明的图形重量。眼周短羽状线和数百个密集小点层层构成灰色纹理环。上方眉状区域更深、排线更密，周围浅纸仍在每个线迹之间可见。左下方，交叠的斑点羽毛形成粗糙纹样色域。眼睛右侧，生物轮廓变得更浅、更不完整，右上方留下大片白空。一只人的手从中央偏右进入，手指握着细深色笔，笔尖触及眼睛外下角旁边。手的塑造比下方画稿更平滑、更柔，让添点的动作清楚，却不与眼睛争焦。画中没有背景场所；纸面和深点与白空之间的对照构成整幅。均匀漫射光使纸页明亮，手下只有一道微弱柔影。密集点描形成最深黑色，稀疏点群则转为中灰，最后消散在未触碰的纸面中。整体构图把非凡细节聚在一个圆形焦点周围，让手与开放白边揭示图像的形成方式。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome image is constructed through countless fine dots, short hatch marks, and deliberate areas of untouched white. Mark density controls value: clustered black points become deep shadow, while sparse stippling makes soft gray transitions without a continuous wash. A sharply bounded circular focal region sits beside dissolving, incomplete contours and generous paper space. Fine grain is inherent to the drawing rather than an added surface effect. Even light preserves the paper's brightness and lets the minute variations in mark size remain visible. The composition feels meticulous yet airy, with technical precision balanced by open space.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色图像由无数细点、短排线和刻意保留的未触白色构成。点痕密度控制明度：聚集的黑点成为深影，稀疏点描则无需连续淡染便形成柔和灰阶过渡。边界锐利的圆形焦点旁，是逐渐消散、不完全的轮廓和充足纸面空间。细颗粒来自画法本身，而非额外表面效果。均匀光保留纸面亮度，使点的大小微差仍可见。构图精密却通透，以技术性精度平衡开阔空处。
theme_en: A hand stippling the edge of a large owl eye on paper
theme_zh: 一只手在纸上为硕大的猫头鹰眼睛边缘添点
name: Stippling
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
